root_cause.summary: Order-sensitive list comparison of two identical LoRA target-name sets.
root_cause.detail: discover_lora_target_modules() sorts names by (layer_index, leaf_name), producing per-layer order k_proj, o_proj, q_proj, v_proj. expected_lora_target_modules() builds names in config order q_proj, k_proj, v_proj, o_proj. Both lists contain the same 120 names; missing=[] and extra=[] prove set equality, but targets != expected_targets compared positionally and raised a false mismatch.
root_cause.classification: implementation bug (validation logic), not data/model/environment failure
